title: 第13章 风属性的飞剑第14章 砍价拿下
content_zh:
最后交易双方成交，有池淮君和赵怀云二人做背书，叶家人丝毫没有怀疑药草的真实性。
当即念做了交易。
三针花归叶家，四千五百灵石也交付给了拍卖场。
而后，拍卖会便结束了。
韩风在小厮的引领下，前去账房结算灵石。
账房先生拿着算盘，啪啪啪算了一通后，对韩风说道，
“四千五百灵石，三七分成，您分得三千一百五十灵石，这是您的灵石，请点清楚。”
账房先生递给韩风一个储物袋，而后便去忙别的了。
储物袋这种东西并不算稀少，一般交易超过一千灵石的，拍卖场都会赠送一个。
点账的人只需要神识一扫，便能够数清楚储物袋内的灵石。
可惜韩风不是筑基强者，没有产生神识，没办法潇洒的去神识一扫。
但为了不露怯，也相信人家这么大的拍卖场，不会去坑他，他便拿着储物袋直接出去了。
来到外面后，他向上次一样，将储物袋滴血认主，而后便将其打开，看到了里面密密麻麻的灵石，一时间也数不清有多少。
“小韩子，发财了发财了，这些灵石你准备分我多少？”
耳边传来了小狐狸的声音，韩风扭头看去，只见小狐狸已经爬了出来，小脑袋探在他的肩头上，眨着大眼睛看着储物袋。
“我要先去买东西，买完了有剩余的给你随便吃。”
“那你可不许全部花完呀，记得给我留一些，要是没有我，你可赚不到这么多灵石。”
小狐狸开心极了，原本韩风只能赚两千五灵石的，现在赚了三千多，多出来的，都是它的功劳。
“我知道了，你别说话了，不要让别人发现。”
韩风收起储物袋，将小狐狸的小脑袋又给按回了包袱里面。

而后，他正了正头上的斗笠，向着前面走去，拐弯的时候还时不时往后面看看，生怕有人跟踪自己。
鬼鬼祟祟的不像是好人。
根据记忆力坊市的位置，韩风拐了几个弯，来到了这片专属于修士的坊市之中。
毕竟这片山之间还是生活着不少凡人的，这些凡人的庞大基数也给阴阳宗提供了弟子来源。
而韩风，也是阴阳宗外围山下山村里的一员，小时候生活在一个农家里，每天与父母一起耕种田地，偶尔也读些书，日子幸福美满，懒懒散散。
后来他十三岁的时候，父母掏空积蓄，给他买了一个杂役弟子的名额，而后便双双失踪了。
他那时候寻找了父母很长一段时间，只要一有休假便下山去寻找，但就是找不到，自家的院子和田地也荒废了。
后来他就放弃了，再加上一直修炼不成，便打算等五年期满后，回老家接着种地晒太阳，过躺平无忧的生活。
但现在不行了，他被叶龙渊记恨上了，还是留在宗门里更加安全一些。
他打算，弄个防护法阵回去，把小院子保护起来，然后……
接着躺平。
这个防御阵法要求也不高，能够坚持到他喊执法队过来就行了。
韩风来到了集镇中最大的珍宝阁，大踏步走了进去。
“道友里边请，请问需要什么类型的法宝，在下可为你引荐。”
门前，一个年轻修士迎了上来，穿着带有店家标志的衣服。
content_en:
In the end, the transaction was concluded, and Chi Huaijun and Zhao Huaiyun endorsed it. The Ye family had no doubts about the authenticity of the medicinal herbs.
I immediately wanted to make a deal.
Three needle flowers returned to the Ye family, and four thousand five hundred spiritual stones were also delivered to the auction house.
Then, the auction ended.
Under the guidance of the servant, Han Feng went to the accounting room to settle the spiritual stones.
The accountant took the abacus, made some calculations, and said to Han Feng,
"Four thousand and five hundred spirit stones, divided into 37 and 70, you will get 3150 spirit stones. This is your spirit stone. Please point it out clearly."
The accountant handed Han Feng a storage bag and then went to do other things.
Storage bags are not that rare. Generally, if the transaction exceeds one thousand spirit stones, the auction house will give one as a gift.
The person counting the accounts can count the spiritual stones in the storage bag with just a sweep of his consciousness.
It's a pity that Han Feng is not a strong foundation-builder and has no spiritual consciousness, so he can't sweep away his spiritual consciousness in a cool way.
But in order not to show any cowardice, and believing that such a large auction house would not trick him, he took the storage bag and went out directly.
After coming outside, he did the same thing as last time, dripping blood into the storage bag to identify its owner, and then opened it and saw the densely packed spiritual stones inside. He couldn't count how many there were at the moment.
"Little Han, I'm getting rich. How much are you going to share these spiritual stones with me?"
The voice of the little fox came to his ears. Han Feng turned around and saw that the little fox had crawled out, with its little head on his shoulder and blinking at the storage bag.
"I'm going to buy something first. After I finish shopping, I'll have some left over for you to eat as you please."
"Then you are not allowed to spend it all. Remember to leave some for me. Without me, you would not be able to earn so many spiritual stones."
The little fox was very happy. Originally, Han Feng could only earn two thousand and five spirit stones, but now he has earned more than three thousand. The extra money is all due to him.
"I understand, stop talking and don't let others find out."
Han Feng put away the storage bag and pushed the little fox's head back into the bag.
Then, he straightened the bamboo hat on his head and walked forward. When he turned the corner, he looked back from time to time, for fear that someone would follow him.
Being sneaky doesn't make you a good person.
According to the location of the memory market, Han Feng turned a few corners and came to this market dedicated to monks.
After all, there are still many mortals living in this mountain, and the huge base of these mortals also provides the Yin Yang Sect with a source of disciples.
Han Feng was also a member of a mountain village outside the Yin Yang Sect. When he was a child, he lived in a farmer's family. He farmed the fields with his parents every day and occasionally read some books. His life was happy and lazy.
Later, when he was thirteen years old, his parents used their savings to buy him a place as a handyman disciple, and then both of them disappeared.
He searched for his parents for a long time at that time. Whenever he had a vacation, he would go down the mountain to look for them, but he could not find them, and his yard and fields were also abandoned.
Later, he gave up, and since he had been unable to practice cultivation, he planned to wait until the five years were up, return to his hometown, continue farming and bask in the sun, and live a carefree life.
But it doesn't work now. He is hated by Ye Longyuan, so it is safer to stay in the sect.
He planned to get a protective magic circle back to protect the small courtyard, and then...
Then lie flat.
This defensive formation is not very demanding, as long as he can persist until he calls the law enforcement team to come over.
Han Feng arrived at the Zhenbao Pavilion, the largest in the market town, and strode in.
"Fellow Taoist, please ask me what type of magic weapon you need. I can recommend it to you."
In front of the door, a young monk came up to him, wearing clothes with the store's logo.
